title: Brown's lost 1929 paper The Minor Quantum
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Brown's lost 1929 paper The Minor Quantum, about 1929 at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: In 1929, he wrote a paper. He was kind of cutting back, but yeah, in 1929 he writes a paper about the minor quantum.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells the story of Townsend Brown, an American scientist and inventor whom he presents as someone who built UFO-like craft long before others claimed to. Michels says that in 1929 Brown wrote a paper called The Minor Quantum, a paper now described as lost. He mentions it as part of Brown's early work on the ideas that Michels says led to those craft.
